&.notes: New ampersand with independently drawn crossing strokes and loop, fitted to this face’s width and weight; no historical ampersand claimed.

J.notes: New J with a flared I-like entry, high contrast and a curved U-like bowl; no independent J is printed.

Z.notes: New Z with the horizontal hairlines of E and a heavy diagonal related to N.

K.notes: New K follows the observed lowercase k’s branching diagonals and the descending capital R terminal; no uppercase K is printed.

b.notes: New b reflects the observed d bowl and ascender; no lowercase b is printed.

q.notes: New q reflects the observed p, retaining its deep stem and high bowl.

w.notes: New lowercase w adapts the observed uncial capital W to the lowercase body; a distinct lowercase impression is not present.

z.notes: New lowercase z follows the reconstructed Z, with its proportions fitted to the observed lowercase.

j.notes: New j retains the observed i dot and stem, with an inferred leftward descender. The hook meets the measured i stem without a stepped join.

f.notes: Reconstructed f replaces the tiny observed trace with a clean drawn hook, upright and t-like crossbar.

x.notes: Reconstructed x replaces the tiny 12-point trace using the observed larger capital X, scaled to the lowercase body.

$.notes: New dollar sign using this face’s observed S and an added vertical stroke; the tiny source symbol is not traced.

V.notes: Reconstructed V replaces the coarse 12-point trace with clear contrasting diagonals. The observed Y supplies the raised right entry spur; the tiny V establishes the basic shape.
